text:
Judging by the plate: it is a wide bowl about 20–22 cm across, filled with mixed greens and three pieces of seasoned cheese. The cheese looks like halloumi or goat cheese, or possibly tofu.

The cheese pieces are each about 5x4x1.5 cm, which is roughly 25–30 g each. Three pieces come to about 80 g.

The greens cover most of the bowl but are loosely piled and low. I estimate about 45 g.

No dressing is visible.
